item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00435","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C09","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a material personnel-action template. Its section 3 groups appointment, promotion, transfer, and other personnel actions and requires that they be temporary pending an employee's return; the child similarly groups appointments, promotions, interagency transfers, reemployment, and reassignment and generally requires them to be nonpermanent. Both directives also couple temporary personnel actions with protected reinstatement or reemployment rights and authorize the Civil Service Commission to prescribe implementing regulations. C09 and C02 overlap with the child's reemployment provisions, but their shared machinery is narrower and less distinctive.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"all promotions, transfers of personnel from one agency to another, and ... reemployment of former Federal employees shall be on a nonpermanent basis","parent_excerpt":"the appointment, promotion, transfer, or other personnel action shall be made on a temporary basis pending the return of the officer or employee in question","explanation":"Both use a closely parallel enumeration of personnel actions and impose temporary or nonpermanent status to preserve another employee's return rights."},{"child_excerpt":"the Commission shall prescribe regulations ... governing the establishment, granting, and exercise of rights to reemployment","parent_excerpt":"any such officer or employee who has, or acquires, a competitive status shall be entitled to the same rights with regard to reinstatement in such agency","explanation":"The temporary-action rule in each directive is linked to a substantive reinstatement or reemployment regime."},{"child_excerpt":"The Civil Service Commission is authorized to prescribe regulations and procedures ... for carrying out its functions and duties under this order.","parent_excerpt":"The Civil Service Commission is authorized ... to prescribe such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this order","explanation":"This implementing authority reinforces the shared administrative structure, though it would not independently establish templating."}]}
